name: medikode-agents
description: Medikode AI pipeline agents for Claude Code: medical coding, audit/reconciliation, remittance (ERA/835), CMS-HCC risk adjustment, and code-combination validation.

plugins.name: medikode-code
plugins.description: Run the Medikode multi-stage medical coding pipeline end to end, from a patient chart to a finalized claim.

plugins.name: medikode-audit
plugins.description: Reconcile AI-generated codes against human-coded codes and chart evidence, flagging unsupported or mismatched codes.

plugins.name: medikode-era
plugins.description: Turn free-text EOB/remittance content into a structured, evidence-traced package and a real ANSI X12 835 file.

plugins.name: medikode-raf
plugins.description: Compute a CMS-HCC Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) score from patient demographics and diagnoses.

plugins.name: medikode-validate
plugins.description: Check CPT/HCPCS/ICD-10 code combinations for compliance issues, grounded in a real NCCI PTP edits dataset.
